name: Hollywoodland
source:
Every classic film noir requires a captivating femme fatale, and when you find yourself starring in a Hollywood epic about the dangerous underbelly of Tinseltown, you can't help but fall head over heels for the most seductive femme fatale of them all.

You travel through time to the 1950s and meet an alluring Hollywood star in the City of Angels. Join Celia Del Rio on the silver screen as you navigate the glittering darkness of Tinseltown. Will you and your co-star make it out alive?

[From [url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/hollywoodland]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每部經典黑色電影都需要一位迷人的蛇蠍美人。當你發現自己成了好萊塢史詩片中的主角，故事描繪的是金城危險的暗面，你不由得深深愛上最具魅力的蛇蠍美人。

你穿越時空來到1950年代，在天使之城遇見一位迷人的好萊塢明星。與西莉婭．德爾里奧一同登上銀幕，在金城光鮮外表下的黑暗中周旋。你和搭檔能活著逃出來嗎？[引自[url=https://nix-hydra-games.itch.io/hollywoodland]Itch.io[/url]]
